svg.title: QUEST 02: LaptopFinder Engine
svg.desc: Decision support platform that ranks laptops against user priorities using a weighted SAW matrix — no sponsored results, pure math. Hardest problem: Spec sheet overload — too many options, no clear winner — SAW-weighted matrix surfaces the right machine for each use case. Tech: Node.js, SAW, Next.js, PostgreSQL. Status: IN PROGRESS.
